in_sanskrit.name: गोपिथा
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who takes care of cows and calves
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: गोप- (go-p-) meaning 'cowherd, protector of cows', इथ- (itha-) meaning 'that' or 'she' in Sanskrit grammar, and ा (a) is a suffix that indicates feminine gender.

in_hindi.name: गोपिथा
in_hindi.meaning: वाँझपूरी गायों और गौमुँड़ों की रक्षा करनेवाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: गोपि- (go-pi-) meaning 'cowherd, protector of cows', था- (tha-) is a Hindi suffix that indicates feminine gender.

in_tamil.name: கோபிதா
in_tamil.long_meaning: கோ- (ko-) meaning 'cow', பி- (pi-) meaning 'protector' or 'guardian', and தா- (tha-) is a Tamil suffix that indicates feminine gender.

in_telugu.name: గోపిథా
in_telugu.long_meaning: గౌ- (gau-) meaning 'cow', పి- (pi-) meaning 'protector' or 'guardian', and థా- (tha-) is a Telugu suffix that indicates feminine gender.

in_marathi.name: Gopitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Protector of Cows
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gopitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Gopitha is the protector and guide of cows. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘go’ meaning cows and ‘pitha’ meaning protector. This name is associated with nurturing, compassion, and motherly love.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Gopitha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu mythology, Gopitha is the protector and guide of cows.
